purpose: Test whether completed-bar stochastic reversal transitions time the next 30 seconds better than merely being in an extreme oscillator state.
independence: Transition is defined by stochastic exit/crossover on completed bars.

public_logic_sources.disclosed_logic: Classic stochastic construction, 20/80 extreme zones, %K/%D crossover signals, and exit-from-extreme signals.

indicator_semantics.stochastic: slow stochastic: raw %K over 14 completed bars using high/low range; slow %K = SMA3(raw %K); %D = SMA3(slow %K)
indicator_semantics.proposal_timing: first executable tick at or after completed signal-bar right edge

R037-STX-C01_M1_D_EXIT20_80.trigger: long when previous %D<20 and current %D>=20; short when previous %D>80 and current %D<=80

R037-STX-C02_M1_KD_CROSS_EXTREME.trigger: long when %K crosses above %D with current %D<20; short when %K crosses below %D with current %D>80

R037-STX-C04_M5_KD_CROSS_EXTREME.trigger: same %K/%D extreme crossover grammar on M5

execution.proposal_entry: first executable tick at/after completed signal bar edge
execution.candidate_rearm: one independent proposal per qualifying completed-bar transition

screen_gate.winner_or_quality_gate: official-win delta nonnegative OR positive net with improved gross loss
